business_profile.business_name: Cold-Pressed Safflower and Sunflower Oil Extraction Unit
business_profile.sub_category: Edible Oil Extraction - Cold Pressed / Wood Pressed
business_profile.business_model: Micro-enterprise oil milling with direct B2C retail and B2B wholesale of oil and oil cake
business_profile.description: Small-scale unit that mechanically extracts oil from safflower and sunflower seeds without heat or chemical solvents using screw expeller or wooden churner (ghani). Produces cold-pressed edible oil and by-product oil cake for animal feed and organic fertilizer. Suitable for rural entrepreneurship leveraging locally grown oilseeds in Kalaburagi district which is a major safflower and sunflower belt of Karnataka.

rural_suitability.reason: Raw material locally grown in Aland, Afzalpur, Jewargi, Kalaburagi; low power requirement; product has strong local demand for healthy cooking oil; by-product market for livestock; fits PMFME micro-enterprise model (10-15 lakh investment) promoted by Karnataka government as per Times of India report on cold-pressed oil mills being typical PMFME units.

taluk_comparison.recommendation_reason: Aland has highest oilseeds area 19153 ha per drought memorandum, largest rural population 342207, lowest direct oil mill competition based on APMC major commodities list showing no oil mill, and KSSIDC industrial estate availability. Kalaburagi taluk second due to strongest demand 829830 population and 6.78 lakh MT warehouse infrastructure but higher competition from existing edible oil extraction units as per NABARD PLP. Jewargi weakest due to low input availability - APMC lists only cotton tur, need to source seeds 35 km away.

seasonality.peak_period: March-April for safflower harvest and post-harvest oil demand, September-October for sunflower kharif harvest and festival season Dasara Diwali when oil demand spikes
seasonality.low_period: June-August monsoon sowing period when seed stocks low and transport disrupted, plus summer May when oil consumption reduces
seasonality.reason: Safflower is rabi only (0.02 lakh ha Kalaburagi 2023-24 per DES) harvested Mar-Apr; Sunflower grown in kharif, rabi, summer but major arrivals Sep-Oct and Jan-Feb per Karnataka Economic Survey and APMC price data Dec average 5050/quintal shows post-harvest peak arrivals
seasonality.business_impact: Revenue may drop 20-30% in lean months if no seed stock; raw material price may rise 15-20% in lean vs harvest
mitigation: Bulk procurement at harvest Mar-Apr and Sep-Oct and store 6 months in elevated godown with neem leaves
Diversify both safflower and sunflower to cover two harvest windows
Offer oil cake promotion during lean to maintain cash flow

financial_model.calculation_methodology: Monthly Revenue = (Seed processed kg * oil yield% / 0.92 density * oil price) + (Seed processed * cake yield% * cake price). Small example: 4000 kg *30% =1200 kg oil /0.92=1304 L *260=339k + 2800 kg cake*20=56k total 395k ~ expected 381k after wastage 3%. Expenses = Raw material 4000kg*50.5 Rs/kg=202k + electricity 20units*25days*8=4000 + labour operator 15000+helper 11000=26000 + packaging 1304 bottles*8=10432 + rent 8000 + transport 10000 + maintenance 5000 + loan interest 11% on term loan 5.54 lakh ~ 5000 per month + misc 10000. Break-even = Initial Investment / Monthly Operating Profit

seven_day_validation_experiment.objective: Validate demand, supplier price, competition and unit economics before investing 8.5-15 lakh

days.activity: Visit APMC Gulbarga Nehru Gunj and APMC Afzalpura and Aland, count oil mills, note sunflower safflower arrivals, price, talk to 3 commission agents
days.target: Collect 5 price quotes for sunflower and safflower seeds, list 3 existing oil mills
days.measurement: Number of competitors found, avg seed price, arrival quantity

days.activity: Interview 20 potential customers - 10 rural households in Aland villages, 5 kirana shops, 5 hotels - show 100ml sample, ask willingness to pay Rs 280/L, subscription
days.target: 15+ positive interest, 5+ willing to pay advance

days.activity: Contact 4 machinery suppliers - Coimbatore IndiaMART 20k-2.3 lakh machines, Surat Vishvas 99k-6.54 lakh, local Kalaburagi fabrication - get quotation for 30 kg/hr cold press + filter
days.measurement: Machine cost, capacity, power, delivery time

days.activity: Test product - Buy 50 kg sunflower seeds from APMC at 5050/quintal, get custom milling at existing Lahoti oil mill compound Gunj Road, measure oil yield, cake weight, taste test with 10 families
days.measurement: Oil yield %, cake recovery, sensory score

days.activity: Attempt actual sales/pre-orders - Take 20L test oil, bottle in 1L PET with simple label, try to sell at Aland weekly santhe and Kalaburagi city kirana on consignment
days.target: Sell at least 10L at Rs 260-300/L or get 15L pre-orders
days.measurement: Litres sold, revenue, customer feedback, repeat intent

days.activity: Calculate unit economics - Seed cost, oil yield, cake sale, packaging, labour, electricity, transport, loan EMI 11% interest 5 year repayment with 6 months grace as per PMFME DPR
days.target: Gross margin >30% and monthly profit > Rs 25000 for small scale
days.measurement: Per litre cost, profit, break-even months = Investment / Monthly profit

days.activity: Decision meeting with family/partner and DIC Kalaburagi Joint Director contact 9902073225, discuss PMFME 35% subsidy max 10 lakh eligibility, need for KSPCB exemption
days.measurement: Decision Proceed/Modify/Do Not Proceed based on 70% criteria met

success_criteria: Seed supplier quote <= Rs 55/kg sunflower, <= Rs 60/kg safflower
Machine quotation <= Rs 3.5 lakh for small scale
seven_day_validation_experiment.decision_rule: Proceed if >=4 success criteria met and no failure criteria; Modify scale/location to Aland if input better; Do Not Proceed if both seed availability and demand fail

government_schemes.scheme_selection_method: Select the five most relevant currently applicable schemes based on verified business eligibility and financial relevance. Verified from PIB, NIFTEM DPR, KVIC, Zeebiz NMEO, The Hindu Karnataka 6000 units, and KMEA Udyogini evaluation.

capital_and_financing.recommended_funding_pathway: Small scale: Own 10% Rs 1.2 lakh + PMFME subsidy 35% max 10 lakh on eligible cost Rs 8.5 lakh = Rs 2.97 lakh + Bank term loan Rs 6.5 lakh via CGTMSE at 11% for 5 years with 6 months grace. If woman entrepreneur, add Udyogini interest subvention and 30% subsidy up to 3 lakh for part of project. If FPO model, apply NMEO-OS grant 33% up to 9.9 lakh for 10-tonne unit reducing loan. Register on Udyam and FSSAI before loan. Approach DIC Kalaburagi Joint Director 9902073225 for EDP training certificate required for PMEGP alternative.
capital_and_financing.important_distinction: Business investment and government-scheme own contribution are different concepts. Business investment 8.5 lakh small includes machinery building etc. Government-scheme own contribution is minimum 10% of project cost (Rs 85k) as per PMFME, rest loan and subsidy. Subsidy not upfront cash but credit-linked after loan disbursement.

final_feasibility.strongest_reason_to_consider: Aland has highest oilseeds area 19153 ha per drought memorandum, lowest direct oil mill competition (APMC major commodities list shows no oil mill), large rural population 342207 and KSSIDC industrial estate 10 acres 4 sheds, plus proximity to Solapur safflower belt for additional sourcing. Input surplus reduces seed cost and transport.
final_feasibility.biggest_risk: Seed price volatility and drought - Kalaburagi 90% rainfed per PLP, market price 5050 vs MSP 7721 gap indicates potential procurement competition; need 6-month storage working capital
final_feasibility.minimum_viable_startup: Small scale 20-30 kg/hr expeller Rs 8.5 lakh investment, 4000 kg seeds per month, 1300 L oil per month, break-even 9.9 months, can start in rented shed 400 sq ft with single phase to 3-phase upgrade
final_feasibility.recommended_scale_for_beginner: Small scale Rs 8.5 lakh or Medium PMFME DPR model Rs 15.07 lakh with 35% subsidy max 10 lakh, 10% own contribution, bank loan 55%, capacity 110000 L per annum at 50-70% utilization
final_feasibility.recommended_validation_before_investment: Execute 7-day validation experiment: visit APMC Gulbarga and Afzalpura for seed price, interview 20 customers in Aland, test 50 kg custom milling yield, attempt 10L sales, calculate unit economics - proceed only if >=4 success criteria met
final_feasibility.loan_readiness: Ready for PMFME - requires Udyam, FSSAI, DPR as per NIFTEM format, 10% own contribution, bank account, land proof. DIC Kalaburagi Joint Director 9902073225 contact for EDP. KSPCB exemption to be sought per minister letter to avoid CFE delay for micro units investment 10-15 lakh.
final_feasibility.overall_data_confidence: Medium - Strong verified data for MSP prices, APMC markets, PMFME subsidy, machinery costs, climate; taluk-level competitor counts estimated based on APMC commodity listings and NABARD PLP generic statement, not complete census

major_data_gaps: Taluk-level exact oil mill count not available - Udyam data not exposed taluk-wise for oil mills, used APMC commodity lists as proxy
Exact sunflower area per taluk for 2023-24 not in DES report - only district level 0.02 lakh ha safflower and overall oilseeds area from drought memorandum
Oil cake local market price in Kalaburagi not verified - used PMFME DPR Rs 22/kg
Electricity tariff and actual power outage hours in Aland Jewargi not verified

data_conflicts.selected_value: 5050 for expense calculation using market price, but risk of price rise to MSP considered
data_conflicts.selection_reason: Conservative expense uses market price but sensitivity to MSP noted

data_conflicts.source_2: Nature's Trunk commercial 33-35% yield per kg safflower
data_conflicts.reason_for_difference: Patent lab scale with moisture control vs commercial whole seed high-quality wood press including cake oil recovery difference
data_conflicts.selection_reason: Commercial wood pressed premium oil includes some cake press, aligns with sunflower 33-39% range MDPI

data_quality.verification_summary: Major factual claims were checked against cited government and institutional sources - DES area report, NABARD PLP 2022-23, NDMA district disaster climate, APMC ReMSL official market details, PIB PMFME and PMEGP subsidy rates, NIFTEM DPR machinery costs, The Hindu MSP procurement prices, MDPI oil extraction yield study. Financial projections and analytical scores are explicitly labelled as Calculated, Estimated, or Inferred where they are not directly reported by an authoritative source.
